global: This ramen features a rich amber, glossy miso broth with froth and visible noodles and toppings. A whole boiled egg, tender chashu pork, and a white ceramic bowl on a light brown wooden table complete the scene.

regions.background: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, oval-shaped surface.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, subtly textured rim.
regions.soup: The miso broth is rich amber, glossy, and frothy, with visible noodles and toppings partially submerged.
regions.egg: A whole boiled egg, pale yellowish-white, smooth and glossy, oval-shaped with subtle surface variations.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, slightly fatty texture with browned edges and visible marbling, irregularly shaped.
